capabilities: Import a Letterboxd export ZIP or watched.csv, or refresh a public profile
Browse the film library with posters, ratings, dates and review history
Search, filter and sort films by title, year, rating, runtime or decade
View clickable rating and release-decade charts and runtime/format breakdowns
Copy rating-grouped film lists or export the library as CSV
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README includes detailed security, testing and network-disclosure sections; no API key or password is requested, and Letterboxd may block automated refresh requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a personal film-watching history, ratings and stats from Letterboxd next to your notes.

relations.evidence: Browse your Letterboxd history in Obsidian.

summary: Letterboxd integration that shows your watched films, ratings, reviews and viewing stats in a sidebar panel or note embed.
